name: Eva Westcott
bio: Harry Stafford's wife, married in 1883 or 1884 - the sources disagree - and still married to him in November 1884, when Whitman was addressing letters to 'Harry and Eva Stafford' jointly. Stafford was the New Jersey farm boy Whitman gave a friendship ring to and shared a bed with; he married Eva Westcott and stayed married, and outlived Whitman by twenty-six years.
